description: This file defines the 'issueTrackerCommands' class, which provides methods for managing issue tracker configurations within the TestLink project, including creating, editing, updating, deleting, and testing connections to issue trackers.

classes.name: issueTrackerCommands
classes.description: A class responsible for handling issue tracker related commands such as create, edit, update, delete, and connection testing within TestLink.
